purpose: offline evaluation profile registry — observational only, not runtime authority

generic_net_state_v1.title: Generic net-state + proposal legality
generic_net_state_v1.description: Default offline profile. Applies durable net-state and proposal legality rules only. Does not apply scene-space ontology heuristics.
limitations: Does not classify dorm/studio in-room repositioning.
Does not infer scene topology from beat prose.
Departure cues may yield ambiguous_threshold rather than success.

dorm_studio_single_space.title: Dorm / studio single-space calibration profile
dorm_studio_single_space.description: Profile-scoped ontology plugin calibrated from Issue #240 Willow/dorm evidence. Not universal canonical truth.
limitations: Valid only for scenarios explicitly bound to this profile.
Does not prove multi-room excursion semantics.
Human adjudication anchors in final viability corpus are calibration-only.

multi_room_excursion_v1.title: Multi-room excursion (stub)
multi_room_excursion_v1.description: Placeholder profile for future Tier B / excursion topology evaluation. No mature scoring rules in #243-B.
limitations: Stub only — emits ambiguous_threshold with explicit limitations.
Not validated against excursion scenarios yet.
Do not use for PASS/FAIL or runtime gating.
